title: Meet the farmers who are keep old traditions alive.
text: If you want to meet the farmers and see first hand the love and knowledge these people have for their craft this is the tour for you. We were lucky enough to see the farmers bring their olive harvest in for pressing and experience fresh wines in the process of aging. This tour was like non other.
author: elizabethhM1352HE

title: Excellent
text: Ivan was excellent and very knowledgeable a both the olive oil and wine tasting tours. The pick up and drop off was easy, The ride was smooth and Ivan pointed out all of the interesting points along the way. Excellent tour and excellent tour guide.
author: warrensZ5039EC

title: Loved it!
text:
I'm usually a DIY travel kind of guy but our friends booked this trip for our group and I'm incredibly grateful that they did!

Ivan was a great tour guide and was super knowledgable about the history of the area. He was also very friendly and open to answering any questions about the tour.

The highlights of my trip was
- getting to learn about the entire olive oil production process from a family operated farm
- learning how to make traditional pa amb tomàquet with the tastiest home grown tomato at Finca Mas Perdut
author: andrew12314111

title: Authentic and Unforgettable
text:
Absolutely my favorite tour in all of Europe, the highlight of my whole trip to Spain. Took us to underrated spots and the guide was super friendly. It had such an authentic feel and wasn’t touristy at all, the tour operator was friends with the olive oil farm owners and the winery owner, which made it feel really special.

title: Amazing taste of Catalan history and culture
text: Hands down one of the best tours I've ever been on. Our guide Ivan and all of the business owners were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. I had a great time, tasted some very unique and delicious food and wines, and learned a lot about Catalan history and culture. 11/10 would recommend.

title: Amazing Experience
text: Our family had an amazing experience with Ivan! Knowledgeable and passionate about his countryside and culture. We thoroughly enjoyed our day trip and will definitely be coming back again. The olive oil and wines are on their way back to the US!
author: Navigate420028

title: Great tour of Tarragona plus winery.
text: This is a great tour with Ivan. He knows a lot of history and told us many interesting stories about Terragona and the local area. He took us on a great tour of the Roman and Medieval ruins of this fascinating city. The tour ends at a Pendes area small family winery. The wines were very good and we especially enjoyed their late harvest wines. You will have a great time on this tour
author: Curious28188210940

title: An unforgettable discovery of Taragona with Ivan!
text:
We spent an exceptional day exploring Tarragona with Ivan, who guided us through the fascinating history of this city. Thanks to him, we explored an incredible Roman theater and the historic center, while enjoying its clear and captivating explanations.

Ivan is not only very friendly, but he shares with a real passion his knowledge of the history of the region and the local wines. The visit ended in style with a stop in a vineyard, where we could discover the know-how and passion of the wine artisans.
